video_title: NBA Finals Game 2 Preview: Must Win For Wemby & Spurs

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's heavy involvement in Spurs team culture and rituals
quotes.excerpt: I was shocked by the level of Wembanyama's involvement. His fingerprints are all over it.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: I was shocked by the level of Wembanyama's involvement. His fingerprints are all over it. I knew there was a PowerPoint presentation with the captains to start us off. There was a meeting on the rooftop bar at the restaurant next to the Spurs practice facility mid-season. That lasted two hours with the entire group, and that's when they came up with the 'bang the drum, boom, boom, clap' type thing.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: So many of the chants that they use, the songs that they play over the loudspeakers, some of the little gestures that they do are straight from him, his suggestions.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's influence on Spurs game presentation and fan engagement
quotes.excerpt: That's something that was a straight up Victor Wembanyama suggestion.
quotes.quote: The TIFO, I just learned last night because I'm not a European football fan, I just learned what a TIFO was. It's those big old banners that they unfurl over the crowd. That's something that was a straight up Victor Wembanyama suggestion.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's post-game ritual of tearing his jersey
quotes.excerpt: He tears off his shirt every game. He gives a big pep talk.
quotes.quote: He tears off his shirt every game. He gives a big pep talk. He had a shirt ready to go. That's right. But again, just another, and by the way, some of their captains, my guy Peyton and some of the other guys, they've got headsets with microphones on so they're communicating directly with the game presentation staff. This thing is a big priority for Victor Wembanyama.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's need to maintain energy levels for the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: For them to be able to win for the next six, I think he's got to have at least two or three games where he has a different level of energy.
quotes.quote: For them to be able to win for the next six, I think he's got to have at least two or three games where he has a different level of energy. Because if he's looking like that, and again, we're talking about, usually there's two days between these games. Because of the World Cup this year, the whole schedule's different, and so it's Wednesday and then Friday. So what's his energy going to be like tomorrow?

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's fourth quarter dominance in Game 1
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson obviously went off in the fourth quarter and had 13 points and no turnovers.
quotes.quote: Jalen Brunson obviously went off in the fourth quarter and had 13 points and no turnovers in the fourth quarter, won the game down the stretch like we've seen him do so many times.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: The historical difficulty of teams coming off a seven-game series
quotes.excerpt: Thirteenth team to defeat the reigning champion in a seven-game series right before the NBA Finals. Among those previous 12, only one of them won the title.
quotes.quote: Thirteenth team to defeat the reigning champion in a seven-game series right before the NBA Finals. Among those previous 12, only one of them won the title. That's what the Knicks are trying to overcome.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper's need for increased playing time for the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: Dylan Harper just has to play more. He has to play more than 27, 28 minutes. He's got to play 35 or 36 minutes.
quotes.quote: Dylan Harper just has to play more. He has to play more than 27, 28 minutes. He's got to play 35 or 36 minutes. Like, he should be getting some of these Harrison Barnes minutes. He should be getting some Dylan Harper minutes. He should be getting uh, Carter Bryant minutes. Like, they need him to play 36 minutes for them to have a chance, I think.
